display.purpose: The one headline figure per card: the day's kcal total, calculator results. Always gradient-clipped.

headline.purpose: Stat-box values and meal group totals.

title.purpose: Recipe names, date-nav label, section titles.

body.purpose: Entry descriptions, dialog copy, form values.

label.purpose: Uppercase wide-tracked micro-labels: section headers, stat labels, macro labels.

unit.purpose: Gram unit mark (.unit-g): italic Georgia serif, the system's one deliberate break from Inter. See The Georgia "g" Rule.

shadows.name: overlay-lift
shadows.purpose: Dropdowns and popovers lifted above content.

shadows.name: hero-card
shadows.purpose: The hero kcal card: grounding shadow plus a glass top-edge highlight.

motion.name: ease-sheet
motion.purpose: Bottom sheet slide-up and overlay transitions — a slight overshoot for a physical, springy arrival.

motion.name: duration-sheet
motion.purpose: Sheet slide-up, list item fade-up entrance.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full-width violet-gradient call to action; the app's one high-emphasis button.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { width: 100%; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--cockpit-violet, #7C6FFF), var(--signal-blue, #5B7FFF)); border: none; border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; color: #fff; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(124,111,255,0.3); transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(124,111,255,0.4); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C4BEFF; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98) translateY(0); box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive-action button; same shape/type as Primary, flat red fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { width: 100%; background: #FF4D6A; border: none; border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; color: #fff; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(255,77,106,0.3); transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { opacity: 0.9; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF8095; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-danger:active { transform: scale(0.98) translateY(0); box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Ghost/Cancel Button
components.description: Low-emphasis dismiss action, always paired below a Primary or Danger button.
components.css: .ds-btn-cancel { width: 100%; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; color: #EEEEFF; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-btn-cancel:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); } .ds-btn-cancel:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C4BEFF; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-cancel:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Segmented Tabs
components.description: Two-up top-level view switcher (e.g. Journal / Bilan).
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2,1fr); gap: 6px; } .ds-tab { border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); color: #6B6B99; padding: 14px 8px; border-radius: 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.3px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C4BEFF; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tab-active { background: rgba(124,111,255,0.1); color: #EEEEFF; border-color: rgba(124,111,255,0.2); box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(124,111,255,0.08); }

components.name: Hero Stat Card
components.description: The signature component: the day's headline number in a gradient-clipped display face over a glowing radial-lit panel, with a progress bar beneath.
components.html:
1 847
kcal aujourd'hui
components.css: .ds-hero-card { position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #0F0F1A 0%, #12102A 100%); border: 1px solid rgba(124,111,255,0.1); border-radius: 28px; padding: 24px 18px 20px; text-align: center; box-shadow: 0 4px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.3), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05); } .ds-hero-glow { position: absolute; top: -60px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 280px; height: 280px; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(124,111,255,0.12) 0%, transparent 65%); pointer-events: none; } .ds-hero-number { position: relative; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 60px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -3px; line-height: 1; background: linear-gradient(135deg,#FFFFFF 35%,#C4BEFF); -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; background-clip: text; } .ds-hero-label { position: relative; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: #6B6B99; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 3px; margin-top: 4px; } .ds-hero-track { position: relative; height: 6px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-radius: 99px; overflow: hidden; margin-top: 16px; } .ds-hero-fill { height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg,#7C6FFF,#9B5CFF); border-radius: 99px; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(124,111,255,0.4); }

components.name: Stat Chip
components.description: Compact 2-up/4-up grid tile for a single labeled metric.
components.css: .ds-stat { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border-radius: 16px; padding: 12px 14px; backdrop-filter: blur(8px); } .ds-stat-label { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1.5px; color: #6B6B99; margin-bottom: 3px; } .ds-stat-val { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.5px; color: #EEEEFF; }

components.name: Macro Pill
components.description: Protein/carbs/fat readout tile — color-locked per the canonical macro mapping (violet/orange/pink).
components.css: .ds-macro { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border-radius: 16px; padding: 10px 8px; text-align: center; } .ds-macro-label { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1.5px; margin-bottom: 3px; } .ds-macro-val { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.5px; color: #EEEEFF; } .ds-macro-prot .ds-macro-label { color: #7C6FFF; } .ds-macro-gluc .ds-macro-label { color: #FF8C42; } .ds-macro-lip .ds-macro-label { color: #F062C0; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Primary text/search field with the system's violet glow-focus state.
components.css: .ds-input { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 14px; padding: 13px 16px; font-size: 15px; color: #EEEEFF; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; width: 100%; outline: none; transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6B6B99; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #7C6FFF; background: rgba(124,111,255,0.06); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(124,111,255,0.1); }

components.name: Bottom Nav Item
components.description: Icon+label button used in the fixed six-item bottom navigation.
components.css: .ds-navitem { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 3px; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 12px; color: #6B6B99; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-navitem-icon { font-size: 20px; } .ds-navitem:hover { color: #7C6FFF; background: rgba(124,111,255,0.1); } .ds-navitem:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C4BEFF; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-navitem:active { transform: scale(0.92); }

narrative.overview:
LeGrosBarbu reads as a private instrument panel checked after dark: near-black ink surfaces (#08080F), glassy blurred layers, and a single electric-violet accent that lights up only what's live — the day's calorie readout, the active tab, a focused field. Nothing else competes for attention. The system is dense and fast rather than spacious: numbers sit close together, labels are small and wide-tracked, and the largest thing on any screen is always the number that matters most right now (calories, a macro total, a body-weight delta), rendered in a gradient-clipped display face with tight negative tracking that reads like a cockpit readout, not a marketing headline.

Depth comes from light, not gray. Ambient violet (and occasionally orange, pink, or green) glow signals "this is live/active/yours," while flat black shadows do the physical work of lifting sheets and dropdowns above the page. Corners are generous almost everywhere — this is a soft, tactile instrument panel, not a hard technical one — except where a sheet meets the bottom edge of the screen, where the rounding stops dead to say "anchored here."

The app has no gamification skin: no mascots, no emoji badges, no bright primary-color reward pops. Confidence comes from precision (tabular numerals, gradient-text hero figures, a Georgia-italic "g" unit mark) rather than decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ink background with a single violet-blue accent gradient — everything else is grayscale until something needs to signal state
Glow-as-elevation: colored ambient shadows for emphasis, neutral black shadows for physical lift
Dense, glassy, mobile-first single column (480px), expanding to a 4-column stat grid past 900px
Bottom sheets round only their top corners — a hard visual signature of "anchored to the bottom edge"
Big gradient-clipped numerals with tight negative letter-spacing for hero stats; wide-tracked uppercase micro-labels everywhere else

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Cockpit Violet is the only color that means "primary action" or "brand." Every other hue is locked to a single semantic role (macro, sport, danger, favorite) and must not be reused as a generic accent.

rules.name: The Macro-Color Rule
rules.body: Protein = violet, Carbs = orange, Fat = pink is the canonical mapping (as shown on the dashboard macro pills). The meal-line macro badges currently use a second, blue/amber/orange mapping — that's drift against this rule, not a second valid system; new work should converge on the dashboard mapping.

rules.name: The Gradient Numeral Rule
rules.body: Any number that is the headline figure of its card (the day's kcal total, a calculator result) is rendered in the display face with the white→lavender gradient text-clip and tight negative tracking — never as flat solid text at that size.

rules.name: The Georgia "g" Rule
rules.body: Gram units (.unit-g) render in italic Georgia serif at 0.9em — a small, deliberate typographic wink that breaks from Inter only for this one unit mark, making weight values feel hand-annotated against the otherwise mechanical numerals.

rules.name: The Glow-Is-Emphasis Rule
rules.body: Colored shadows always mean "live, active, or emphasized" — never plain decoration. If a colored glow appears on a static/inactive element, that's a bug, not a style choice. Anything that needs to visually float above other content (sheet, dropdown, popover) uses the neutral black overlay-lift shadow instead, regardless of what color the element itself is.

rules.name: The Half-Round Sheet Rule
rules.body: Every bottom sheet and modal rounds only its top two corners (28px 28px 0 0 / 24px 24px 0 0) and never its bottom corners — the flat bottom edge is what tells the eye "this is anchored to the screen edge, not floating."

dos: Do reserve Cockpit Violet for primary actions, active/live state, and protein — never as a generic decorative accent.
Do use colored ambient glow only to mean "this is live, active, or emphasized"; use neutral black shadow for anything physically overlaying content.
Do round bottom sheets and modals on the top corners only (28px 28px 0 0) — never all four.
Do render any card's headline figure in the gradient-clipped display face with tight negative tracking, not as flat solid text.
Do keep spacing dense (6–16px rhythm) — this is a daily-logging tool, not a landing page; don't add marketing-scale whitespace.
donts: Don't introduce gray/neutral drop shadows on live, interactive cards — depth there comes from colored glow, not gray shadow.
Don't add bright multi-color gamification, mascots, emoji badges, or reward-pop UI — the palette stays restrained to one accent plus role-locked semantic colors.
Don't give a bottom sheet or modal rounded bottom corners — it breaks the "anchored to the edge" signature.
Don't invent a third macro-color mapping. Converge new work on violet/orange/pink (protein/carbs/fat); treat the existing blue/amber/orange meal-line badges as drift to fix, not a pattern to extend.
Don't use Favorite Gold as a general highlight color — it's reserved for favorites and user-created/custom items.
